exposure: Subarachnoid Block (SAB) for elective cesarean section
General Anesthesia (GA) for elective cesarean section
outcome: Blood loss up to 24 hours postpartum
Hemodynamic profiles (systolic blood pressure, diastolic blood pressure, mean arterial blood pressure, heart rate)
cohort: Four hundred and seventy-eight consecutive women scheduled for elective cesarean section.
finding: Intraoperative maternal blood loss and ephedrine consumption were significantly higher among parturients who received General Anesthesia compared to those who received Subarachnoid Block for elective cesarean sections, with no significant difference in Apgar scores or umbilical pH.
